text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mauritania President Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya to visit Tunisia on Saturday.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali to visit France in May.
- Tunisian-Egyptian high commission to hold its 5th meeting in Tunis on Friday.
- Arab ministers of culture end their conference and adopt a declaration which supports Palestinian claim over Jerusalem.
- Rome Mayor Fransesco Rutelli says Tunisia is a leading country in the field of environment protection. Tunis and Rome signed an accord for exchanges of expertise over environment issues.
- Family planning will be extended to the country's remote areas.
- Tunisia to extend motorway network to the northern city of Bizert.
- Tunisia calls on Arab countries to draw a plan to upgrade and promote culture industry.
